content: We shortlisted 5 CRM tools for a 20-person sales team: Attio, HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive, and Folk. Can you compare their current list prices?

For a 20-person team I compared the public list prices I could find that morning.

Attio was $29 per user per month on the Plus plan.
HubSpot Sales Hub Starter was $20 per seat per month.
Close was $49 per user per month on the Growth plan.
Pipedrive Essential was $14 per seat per month, billed annually.
Folk was $24 per user per month on the Standard plan.

Those are list prices, not negotiated quotes. Sources: https://attio.com/pricing https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales https://www.close.com/pricing https://www.pipedrive.com/en/pricing https://www.folk.app/pricing
summary: Shortlisted Attio, HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive, and Folk for a 20-person sales team and recorded list prices.

content: Is the Postgres 17 release considered stable for production?

Yes. Postgres 17 went generally available in September 2024, and by 3 November 2026 it was a normal production choice as long as the extensions you need support it. Source: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/release-17.html
summary: Said Postgres 17 was generally available and fine for production if extensions support it.
